Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import RecordTypes InertContext TFree.

Class MutableReachability := mutable_reachability: ctx -> config -> var -> Prop.

Notation "F ⊢ C 'mreach' y" := (mutable_reachability F C y) (at level 40, C at level 59).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive mut_reach : MutableReachability :=





| mreach_fld : forall (F : ctx) (t : trm) (fs : stack) (e : renv) (Sigma : heap) Lv
                 (y1 y2 : var) (ds : defs) (a : fld_label),

    inert F ->

    F ⊢ (t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) mreach y1 ->

    binds y1 (item_obj ds) Sigma -> defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f y2)) ->

    F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y1) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot
        (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) ->

    F ⊢ (t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) mreach y2






| mreach_trm : forall (F : ctx) (t : trm) (fs : stack) (e : renv) (Sigma : heap) Lv
                 (y w : var),

    inert F ->

    (tfree w t) \/ (tfree w fs) ->

    binds w y e ->

    F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f w) ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) ->

    F ⊢ (t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) mreach y
.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_stack : ctx -> renv -> typ -> stack -> typ -> Prop :=
  | ty_stack_nil : forall G e T U,
      G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
      ty_stack G e T stack_nil U
  | ty_stack_let : forall L G e s t S T U,
      ty_stack G e T s U ->
      (forall x,
          x \notin L ->
          G § x / v_let ~ S ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ T) ->
      ty_stack G e S (stack_cons (frame_let t) s) U.

Inductive heap_closed: heap -> Prop :=
| heap_closed_empty: heap_closed empty
| heap_closed_push S x i:
    heap_closed S ->
    closed i ->
    heap_closed (S & x ~ i)
.

Inductive config_closed: config -> Prop:=
  config_sealed_cfg t s Sigma e Lv:
    closed t ->
    closed s ->
    heap_closed Sigma ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv).

Inductive ty_config : ctx -> config -> typ -> Prop :=
| ty_config_c : forall G e s Sigma Lv t T U,
    inert G ->

    all_tfree_k_stack G s v_ref ->

    ty_nothing_fresh_in_config G U (t ; s ; Sigma ; e; Lv) ->
    has_null Lv ->
    sealed G ->
    config_closed (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    closed U ->
    ty_config G (t; s; Sigma; e; Lv) U.

Inductive config_typd : config -> typ -> Prop :=
| config_typd_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_typd c U.

Inductive config_hastyp : config -> Prop :=
| config_hastyp_c : forall Gamma c U,
    ty_config Gamma c U ->
    config_hastyp c.

Inductive config_initial: trm -> config -> Prop :=

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Deref HeapUpdate.

Reserved Notation "t1 ↦ t2" (at level 40, t2 at level 39).

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_read : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yVal wVal ds fs,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil) (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->
    (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wVal); fs; Sigma; e & wVal ~ yVal; fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_write : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yArg wArg Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma'; e; fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_call : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv wArg t ds fs,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_apply : forall yFun wFun wArg Sigma e Lv t fs,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_fun : forall T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_obj : forall T ds t Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma e Lv x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_push : forall s t fs Sigma e Lv,
    (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (s; (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

Reserved Notation "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2"
         (at level 40, n at level 41, C2 at level 39).

Inductive red_closure :  config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=

| red_refl : forall (C : config),
    C ⊣ 0 ↦* C

| red_trans : forall (C1 C2 C3 : config) (n : nat),
    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types Terms Envs.

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj: defs -> item
  | item_fun: trm -> item.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => (fv ds)
  | item_fun t => (fv t)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (open_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (open_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemOpenable : Openable item := open_rec_item.

Definition subst_item x y (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (subst_var x y ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (subst_var x y t)
  end.

Instance ItemSubstVar : SubstVar item := subst_item.

Instance ItemAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax ItemOpenable ItemFreeVar ItemSubstVar := {}.

Definition seal_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj ds => item_obj (seal_rec n x ds)
  | item_fun t => item_fun (seal_rec (S n) x t)
  end.

Instance ItemSealable : Sealable item := seal_rec_item.

Definition collect_item {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (it: item) : C :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (collect df f comb ds)
  | item_fun t => (collect df f comb t)
  end.

Instance ItemCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_item.

Definition transform_item (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (it : item) (n : nat) : item :=
  match it with
  | item_obj ds => (item_obj (transform f ds n))
  | item_fun t => (item_fun (transform f t (S n)))
  end.

Instance ItemTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax ItemAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_item.

Notation heap := (env item).

Notation fv_heap Sigma := ((@dom item Sigma) \u (fv_env Sigma)).

Definition subst_heap x y : heap -> heap := map (subst_var x y).

Notation subheap_unchanged S1 S2 :=
  (forall y itm, binds y itm S1 -> binds y itm S2) (only parsing).

Class Fields (A: Type) :=
  fields: A -> vars.

Definition fields_def d: vars :=
  match d with
    | def_typ A T => \{}
    | def_met a t => \{}
    | def_fld a (avar_f x) => \{x}
    | def_fld a (avar_b n) => \{}
  end.

Instance FieldsDef: Fields def := fields_def.

Fixpoint fields_defs ds: vars :=
  match ds with
    | defs_nil => \{}
    | defs_cons ds d => (fields_defs ds) \u (fields d)
  end.

Instance FieldsDefs: Fields defs := fields_defs.

Fixpoint fields_item it: vars :=
  match it with
    | item_fun f => \{}
    | item_obj ds => (fields ds)
  end.

Instance FieldsItem: Fields item := fields_item.

Fixpoint fields_heap (S: heap) : vars :=
  match S with
    | nil%list => \{}
    | ((y,ds)::E)%list => (fields_heap E) \u (fields ds)
  end.

Instance FieldsHeap: Fields heap := fields_heap.

Class FieldsInFv (A: Set) {AF: Fields A}{AV: FreeVar A} :=
  fields_in_fv (a: A): fields a \c fv a.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping TypingContext.

Class Unhiding (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  unhiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):
    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b ->
    property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b.

Class Hiding (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  hiding G1 G2 Go e (a: A) (b: B):
    property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b ->
    property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Section UnhidingLemmata.

Context {A B: Set}{P: TypingProperty A B}{AW: Unhiding P}.

End UnhidingLemmata.

Section HidingLemmata.

Context {A B: Set}{P: TypingProperty A B}{AW: Hiding P}.

End HidingLemmata.

Definition UnhidingInd (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  forall G Go e (a: A) (b: B),
    property G Go e a b ->
    forall G1 G2,
      G = (ctx_hide G1) §& G2 ->
      property (G1 §& G2) Go e a b.

Definition UnhidingTInd (A: Set) (t: Typing A) := UnhidingInd obj_typing.

Definition UnhidingDInd (A: Set) (t: DecTyping A) := UnhidingInd obj_dec_typing.

Definition UnhidingIncapInd (_ : ReferenceIncapacitate) :=
  UnhidingInd obj_ref_incap.

Definition UnhidingCapbndInd (C : typ_refcap_label) (_ : CapabilityBound C) :=
  UnhidingInd obj_cap_bnd.

Definition HidingInd (A B: Set) (property: TypingProperty A B) :=
  forall G Go e (a: A) (b: B),
    property G Go e a b ->
    forall G1 G2,
      G = G1 §& G2 ->
      property ((ctx_hide G1) §& G2) Go e a b.

Definition HidingTInd (A: Set) (t: Typing A) := HidingInd obj_typing.

Definition HidingDInd (A: Set) (t: DecTyping A) := HidingInd obj_dec_typing.

Definition HidingIncapInd (_ : ReferenceIncapacitate)
  := HidingInd obj_ref_incap.

Definition HidingCapbndInd (C : typ_refcap_label) (_ : CapabilityBound C)
  := HidingInd obj_cap_bnd.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

End WithTypingMode.
===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_var : Typing var :=

| ty_var_var : forall G e x T,
    ctx_binds x T G ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T

| ty_rec_intro : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->

    ((mode_has_incap typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ (open x T) ∶icp (open x T))) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T

| ty_rec_elim : forall G e x T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_bnd T ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ open x T

| ty_var_and : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_and T U

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Constructive_sets.

Inductive ctx: Set :=

| ctx_empty

| ctx_push: ctx -> var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx

| ctx_stop: ctx -> ctx

| ctx_hide: ctx -> ctx
.

Notation "G '§' v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push G v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push ctx_empty v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʸ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_loc T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʷ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_ref T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʳ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_recv T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ᶻ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_par T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˢ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_self T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˣ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_let T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1
| ctx_push c v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_concat G1 c) v vk t
| ctx_stop c => ctx_stop (ctx_concat G1 c)
| ctx_hide c => ctx_hide (ctx_concat G1 c)
end.

Notation "E §& F" := (ctx_concat E F)
  (at level 28, left associativity) : env_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_map(fn: typ -> typ)(G: ctx): ctx :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => ctx_empty
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_map fn G1) v vk (fn t)
| ctx_stop G1 => ctx_stop (ctx_map fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => ctx_hide (ctx_map fn G1)
end.

Fixpoint ctx_collect_values(A: Set)(fn: typ -> fset A)(G: ctx): fset A :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => (fn t) \u (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_stop G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
end.

Notation ctx_fv := (ctx_collect_values fv).

Instance CtxFreeVar : FreeVar ctx := ctx_fv.

Fixpoint ctx_keys(G: ctx): list var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => nil
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  v :: (ctx_keys G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_keys G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_keys G
end.

Fixpoint ctx_dom(G: ctx): fset var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  \{ v } \u (ctx_dom G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_dom G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_dom G
end.

Notation "x '§#' E" := (x \notin (ctx_dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:
  ctx_weakens G ->
  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation "z '/[#' n '->' y ']'" :=
  (open_rec n y z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Notation "z '/[->' y ']'" :=
  (open y z) (at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

  (open_rec_vars n ys z) (n at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Sealable.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Context Defs Heap.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
.

Scheme tfree_trm_mut    := Induction for tfree_trm Sort Prop
with   tfree_lit_mut    := Induction for tfree_lit Sort Prop
with   tfree_def_mut    := Induction for tfree_def Sort Prop
with   tfree_defs_mut   := Induction for tfree_defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme tfree_mutind from tfree_trm_mut, tfree_lit_mut,
tfree_def_mut, tfree_defs_mut.

Inductive tfree_stack: TFree stack :=

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Defs GeneralTyping Equivalence Indep.

Fixpoint deref_base A (su: SubstVar A) (e: renv) (X: A): A :=
  match e with
  | nil => X
  | cons (w,y) ys => (deref_base su ys (subst_var w y X))
  end.

Class Deref A :=
  deref (e: renv) (a: A): A.

Instance deref_var: Deref var := deref_base VarSubstVar.

Instance deref_avar: Deref avar := deref_base AvarSubstVar.

Instance deref_def: Deref def :=
fun e d => match d with
| def_fld l x => def_fld l (deref e x)
| def_met l t => def_met l t
| def_typ l T => def_typ l T
end.

Fixpoint deref_defs_fix(e: renv)(ds: defs) :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => defs_nil
| defs_cons ds d => defs_cons (deref_defs_fix e ds) (deref_def e d)
end.

Instance deref_defs: Deref defs := deref_defs_fix.

Class DerefInFv (A: Set) (AD: Deref A) (AF: FreeVar A):=
  deref_in_fv x e (d: A):
    x \in fv (deref e d) ->
    x \in fv d \/ x \in fv_env e.
===
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import TypingMode.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Notation vis_hide typing_mode G := (
  match (mode_visibility' typing_mode) with
  | mode_visibility_all => G
  | mode_visibility_hide_method => (ctx_hide G)
  end
  ) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj_met typing_mode (G: ctx)(Go: objctx)(xz: var)(TZ: typ)(xc: var)(TC: typ) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => ctx_met (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC
  | objctx_lit x T => ctx_met_refined (vis_hide typing_mode (G § x / v_self ~ open x T)) xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open x T) (open xc T))
  | objctx_heap y T => ctx_met_refined_heap (vis_hide typing_mode G) xz TZ xc TC y T

  end.
====
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Types Context.

Inductive objctx: Set :=

| objctx_empty: objctx
| objctx_lit(x: var)(T: typ): objctx
| objctx_heap(y: var)(T: typ): objctx
.

Notation ctx_met G xz TZ xc TC := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (open xz TC)).

Notation open_met xz xc T := (open xz (open_rec 1 xc T)) (only parsing).

Notation close_met z r T := (close z (close_rec 1 r T)) (only parsing).

Definition ctx_obj(G: ctx)(Go: objctx) :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => G
  | objctx_lit x T => G § x / v_self ~ open x T
  | objctx_heap y T => G
  end.

Notation ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC TC2 := (G § xz / v_par ~ TZ § xc / v_recv ~ (typ_and (open xz TC) TC2)).

Notation ctx_met_refined_heap G xz TZ xc TC y T := (ctx_met_refined G xz TZ xc TC (typ_and (open y T) (open xc T))).

Definition subst_objctx vSrc vDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_var vSrc vDst y) (subst_var vSrc vDst T)
  end.

Notation "G '/[§§' x '->' y ']'" :=
  (subst_objctx x y G) (x at level 69, at level 7, left associativity) : syntax_scope.

Definition subst_objctx_pvars xs ys Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_pvars xs ys y) (subst_pvars xs ys T)
  end.

Definition subst_objctx_varx vsSrc vsDst Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  | objctx_heap y T => objctx_heap (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst y) (subst_vars vsSrc vsDst T)
  end.

Definition objctx_dom Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => \{ x }
  | objctx_heap y T => \{}
  end.

Definition objctx_keys Go: list var :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => nil
  | objctx_lit x T => x::nil
  | objctx_heap y T => nil
  end.

Definition objctx_fv Go :=
  match Go with
  | objctx_empty => \{}
  | objctx_lit x T => fv T
  | objctx_heap y T => \{y} \u (fv T)
  end.

Notation "G '§§&' Go" := (ctx_obj G Go)  (at level 28, left associativity).

Fixpoint objctx_seal_rec n y G {struct G} :=
  match G with
  | objctx_empty => objctx_empty
  | objctx_heap x T => objctx_heap x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  | objctx_lit x T => objctx_lit x (seal_rec (S n) y T)
  end.

Instance ObjctxSealable: Sealable objctx := objctx_seal_rec.

| basic_incap | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_incap_nocap
| rodot => mode_incap_structural
| _ => mode_incap_none
end.

Definition mode_has_incap' m: bool := match (mode_incap' m) with
| mode_incap_none => false
| _ => true
end.

Notation mode_has_incap m := ((mode_has_incap' m) = true)(only parsing).

Inductive mode_ty_inv := mode_ty_inv_flat | mode_ty_inv_layered.

Definition mode_ty_inv' m: mode_ty_inv := match m with
| basic_incap | rodot_top_nm | rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_compl_muttop | rodot_sef => mode_ty_inv_layered
| _ => mode_ty_inv_flat
end.

Inductive mode_sef := mode_sef_none | mode_sef_guarantee.

Definition mode_sef' m : mode_sef := match m with
| rodot_sef |  rodot_nm_muttop | rodot_nm_compl | rodot_nm_compl_muttop  | basic_sef_typing => mode_sef_guarantee
| _ => mode_sef_none
end.

Notation mode_has_sef m := ((mode_sef' m) = mode_sef_guarantee)(only parsing).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect Types.

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_read  : avar -> fld_label -> trm
  | trm_apply  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_write  : avar -> fld_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_call: avar -> met_label -> avar -> trm

with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_obj  : typ -> defs -> lit

with def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_fld  : fld_label -> avar -> def
  | def_met  : met_label -> trm -> def

with defs : Set :=
  | defs_nil : defs
  | defs_cons : defs -> def -> defs.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop
with   def_mut  := Induction for def  Sort Prop
with   defs_mut := Induction for defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut, def_mut, defs_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (open_rec (S k) u T)
      (open_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (open_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (open_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
open_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (open_rec_defs k u tl) (open_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmOpenable : Openable trm := open_rec_trm.

Instance LitOpenable : Openable lit := open_rec_lit.

Instance DefOpenable : Openable def := open_rec_def.

Instance DefsOpenable : Openable defs := open_rec_defs.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a         => (fv a)
  | trm_read x m       => (fv x)
...
  | trm_read x m       => (fv x)
  | trm_apply f a       => (fv f) \u (fv a)
  | trm_let t1 t2     => (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  | trm_lit l t       => (fv_lit l) \u (fv_trm t)
  | trm_write x m y     => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | trm_call x m y => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  end with
fv_lit (l: lit) : vars :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e    => (fv T) \u (fv_trm e)
  | lit_obj T ds => (fv T) \u (fv_defs ds)
  end with
fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (fv T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (fv v)
  | def_met _ t     => (fv_trm t)
  end with
fv_defs(ds: defs) : vars :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => \{}
  | defs_cons tl d   => (fv_defs tl) \u (fv_def d)
  end.

Instance TrmFreeVar : FreeVar trm := fv_trm.

Instance LitFreeVar : FreeVar lit := fv_lit.

Instance DefFreeVar : FreeVar def := fv_def.

Instance DefsFreeVar : FreeVar defs := fv_defs.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: var) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var x        => trm_var (subst_var z u x)
  | trm_read x1 L     => trm_read (subst_var z u x1) L
  | trm_apply x1 x2    => trm_apply (subst_var z u x1) (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => trm_let (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => trm_lit (subst_lit z u l) (subst_trm z u t)
  | trm_write x1 L x2  => trm_write (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_call x1 L x2  => trm_call (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  end with
subst_lit (z: var) (u: var) (l: lit) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t   => lit_fun (subst_var z u T) (subst_trm z u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj (subst_var z u T)
            (subst_defs z u ds)
  end with
subst_def (z: var) (u: var) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ l t => def_typ l (subst_var z u t)
  | def_fld l v => def_fld l (subst_var z u v)
  | def_met l t => def_met l (subst_trm z u t)
  end with
subst_defs (z: var) (u: var) (ds: defs) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil => defs_nil
  | defs_cons rest d => defs_cons (subst_defs z u rest) (subst_def z u d)
  end.

Instance TrmSubstVar : SubstVar trm := subst_trm.

Instance LitSubstVar : SubstVar lit := subst_lit.

Instance DefSubstVar : SubstVar def := subst_def.

Instance DefsSubstVar : SubstVar defs := subst_defs.

Fixpoint seal_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (seal_rec k u a)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (seal_rec k u v) m
  | trm_apply f a    => trm_apply (seal_rec k u f) (seal_rec k u a)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (seal_rec_trm k u t1) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit l t => trm_lit (seal_rec_lit k u l) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (seal_rec k u v) m (seal_rec k u v2)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (seal_rec k u v) m (seal_rec k u v2)
  end with
seal_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (seal_rec k u T) (seal_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (seal_rec (S k) u T)
      (seal_rec_defs (S k) u ds)

  end with
seal_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def): def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (seal_rec (S k) u T)
  | def_fld m v => def_fld m (seal_rec k u v)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (seal_rec_trm (S (S k)) u e)
  end with
seal_rec_defs (k: nat) (u: var) (ds: defs): defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (seal_rec_defs k u tl) (seal_rec_def k u d)
  end.

Instance TrmSealable : Sealable trm := seal_rec_trm.

Instance LitSealable : Sealable lit := seal_rec_lit.

Instance DefSealable : Sealable def := seal_rec_def.

Instance DefsSealable : Sealable defs := seal_rec_defs.

Instance TrmAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TrmOpenable TrmFreeVar TrmSubstVar := {}.

Instance LitAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax LitOpenable LitFreeVar LitSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefOpenable DefFreeVar DefSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefsAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefsOpenable DefsFreeVar DefsSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefLabelOf : LabelOf def :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | def_typ L _ => label_typ L
      | def_fld m _ => label_fld m
      | def_met m _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_trm {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (t: trm) : C :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a       => (f a)
  | trm_read x m      => (f x)
  | trm_apply f' a      => comb (f f') (f a)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => comb (collect_trm df f comb t1) (collect_trm df f comb t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => comb (collect_lit df f comb l) (collect_trm df f comb t)
  | trm_write x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | trm_call x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  end with
collect_lit {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (l: lit) : C :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e  => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_trm df f comb e)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses AbstractSyntax.

Require Import Vars Types Context Env Equivalence.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Inductive typ_indep: avar -> typ -> Prop :=
| typ_indep_nulary v T:
  typ_nulary T -> typ_indep v T

| typ_indep_and v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_typ_b n a t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_typ a t1 t2))
| typ_indep_fun_f v t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fun_b n t1 t2:
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_fun t1 t2)
| typ_indep_sel(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    v <> v1 ->
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| typ_indep_sel_normal(v v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    v <> v2 ->
    typ_indep v (typ_sel v1 (typ_label_normal l) v2)
| typ_indep_bnd_f v t:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_bnd_b n t:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_bnd t)
| typ_indep_met_f v t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_f v) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
| typ_indep_met_b n t1 t2 t3 l:
    typ_indep (avar_b (S n)) t1 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) t2 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b (S (S n))) t3 ->
    typ_indep (avar_b n) (typ_rcd (dec_met l t1 t2 t3))
.

Notation typ_indep_f v T := (typ_indep (avar_f v) T).

Notation typ_indep_b n T := (typ_indep (avar_b n) T).

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra Vars Terms Heap Env SyntaxClasses TransformCollect Bool.

Inductive frame : Set :=
  | frame_let : trm -> frame.

Inductive stack: Set :=
  | stack_nil: stack
  | stack_cons (f: frame) (fs: stack): stack
.

Fixpoint stack_length (fs : stack) : nat :=
  match fs with
  | stack_nil => 0
  | stack_cons _ fs' => (stack_length fs') + 1
  end.

Definition frame_fv fr := match fr with frame_let c => fv c end.

Instance FrameFreeVar : FreeVar frame := frame_fv.

Fixpoint stack_fv s: vars :=
  match s with
  | stack_nil => \{}
  | stack_cons f fs => (fv f) \u (@fv stack stack_fv fs)
  end.

Instance StackFreeVar : FreeVar stack := stack_fv.

Definition frame_subst_var x y fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (subst_var x y c) end.

Instance FrameSubstVar: SubstVar frame := frame_subst_var.

Fixpoint stack_subst_var x y st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (subst_var x y f) (@subst_var stack stack_subst_var x y fs)
  end.

Instance StackSubstVar: SubstVar stack := stack_subst_var.

Definition frame_open n x fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (open_rec n x c) end.

Instance FrameOpenable: Openable frame := frame_open.

Fixpoint stack_open n x st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (open_rec (S n) x f) (@open_rec stack stack_open n x fs)
  end.

Instance StackOpenable:  Openable stack := stack_open.

Instance FrameAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax FrameOpenable FrameFreeVar FrameSubstVar := {}.

Instance StackAbstractSyntax :

match ds with
| defs_nil => None
| defs_cons ds' d => If label_of d = l then Some d else get_def l ds'
end.

Definition defs_has(ds: defs)(d: def) := get_def (label_of d) ds = Some d.

Definition fld_label: Set := string.

| typ_refcap_mutability
.

.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax.

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_fun t11 t12) (typ_fun t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| tyq_typ_bnd(e: renv)(t1 t2: typ):
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_bnd t1) (typ_bnd t2)
| tyq_typ_met m (e: renv) t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    (forall x y, typing_equiv e (open_met x y t13) (open_met x y t23)) ->

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping ConfigTyping.
Require Import OperationalSemantics MutableReachability.

Section WithRodotMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).
Context (Hmm: mode_has_mutability typing_mode).

Context (write_mreach :
  forall (F:ctx) (T:typ) (C1 C2:config) (n:nat) (yObj wObj:var)
         (m:fld_label) (yArg:var) (fs:stack) (Sigma:heap) (e:renv) (Lv:fset var),
    ty_config F C1 T ->
    red_closure C1 n C2 ->
    C2 = config_mk (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f yArg)) fs Sigma e Lv ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    F ⊢ C1 mreach yObj).

Lemma binds_in_dom A (S : env A) x v : @binds A x v S -> x \in dom S.
Proof. intros H. unfolds in H. eapply get_some_inv. eassumption. Qed.

Lemma fresh_head_notin_dom (S : heap) (t : trm) (st : stack)
      (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
     (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  y \notin dom S.
Proof.
  intros Hf.
  unfold fresh_in_config in Hf.
  cbn [LibList.length] in Hf.
  destruct Hf as [Hy _].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [_ Hy].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [_ Hy].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [Hy _].
  unfold fv_heap in Hy.
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_fresh_head_neq (S : heap) (it : item) (z : var) (t : trm)
      (st : stack) (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  binds z it S ->
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  z <> y.
Proof.
  intros Hb Hf.
  intros E; subst z.
  apply (fresh_head_notin_dom Hf).
  eapply binds_in_dom. eassumption.
Qed.

(* Main reduction induction, modulo the write-target lemma. *)
Lemma immutability_aux (F : ctx) (T : typ) (C1 : config) :
  ty_config F C1 T ->
  forall n C2, C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    forall y ds, binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C1) ->
      binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C2) \/ F ⊢ C1 mreach y.
Proof.
  intros Hty n C2 Hred.
  induction Hred as [C | C1' C2' C3' n' Hred' Hstep IH].
  - intros y ds Hb. left. exact Hb.
  - intros y ds Hb.
    destruct (IH y ds Hb) as [Hpres | Hmr]; [| right; assumption].
    destruct Hstep as
      [ yObj0 wObj0 m0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 yVal0 wVal0 ds0 fs0 Hfresh Hbw0 Hby0 Hdf0
      | yObj0 wObj0 m0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 yArg0 wArg0 Sigma0' fs0 Hu0 Hbw0 Hby0
      | yObj0 wObj0 m0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 wArg0 t0 ds0 fs0 Hby0 Hdf0 Hbw0
      | yFun0 wFun0 wArg0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 t0 fs0 Hby0 Hbw0
      | T0 t10 t20 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 y0 w0 fs0 Hfresh0 Hneq0
      | T0 ds0 t0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 y0 w0 fs0 Hfresh0 Hneq0
      | t0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 x0 fs0
      | s0 t0 fs0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 ].
    + (* red_read: heap unchanged *) left. exact Hpres.
    + (* red_write *)
      destruct (classic (y = yObj0)) as [-> | Hneq].
      * right.
        eapply write_mreach; eauto.
      * left.
        unfold heap_update in Hu0.
        destruct Hu0 as (_ & _ & _ & Hpreserve & _).
        eapply Hpreserve; eauto.
    + (* red_call: heap unchanged *) left. exact Hpres.
    + (* red_apply: heap unchanged *) left. exact Hpres.

Lemma binds_in_dom A (S : env A) x v : @binds A x v S -> x \in dom S.
Proof. intros H. unfolds in H. eapply get_some_inv. eassumption. Qed.

Lemma fresh_head_notin_dom (S : heap) (t : trm) (st : stack)
      (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil)
     (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  y \notin dom S.
Proof.
  intros Hf.
  unfold fresh_in_config in Hf.
  cbn [LibList.length] in Hf.
  destruct Hf as [Hy _].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [_ Hy].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [_ Hy].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [Hy _].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_fresh_head_neq (S : heap) (it : item) (z : var) (t : trm)
      (st : stack) (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  binds z it S ->
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  z <> y.
Proof.
  intros Hb Hf.
  intros E; subst z.
  apply (fresh_head_notin_dom Hf).
  eapply binds_in_dom. eassumption.
Qed.

(* Main reduction induction, modulo the write-target lemma. *)
Lemma immutability_aux (F : ctx) (T : typ) (C1 : config) :
  ty_config F C1 T ->
  forall n C2, C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    forall y ds, binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C1) ->
      binds y (item_obj ds) (config_heap C2) \/ F ⊢ C1 mreach y.
Proof.
  intros Hty n C2 Hred.
  induction Hred as [C | C1' C2' C3' n' Hred' IH Hstep].
  - intros y ds Hb. left. exact Hb.
  - intros y ds Hb.
    destruct (IH Hty y ds Hb) as [Hpres | Hmr]; [| right; assumption].
    destruct Hstep as
      [ yObj0 wObj0 m0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 yVal0 wVal0 ds0 fs0 Hfresh Hbw0 Hby0 Hdf0
      | yObj0 wObj0 m0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 yArg0 wArg0 Sigma0' fs0 Hu0 Hbw0 Hby0
      | yObj0 wObj0 m0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 wArg0 t0 ds0 fs0 Hby0 Hdf0 Hbw0
      | yFun0 wFun0 wArg0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 t0 fs0 Hby0 Hbw0
      | T0 t10 t20 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 y0 w0 fs0 Hfresh0 Hneq0
      | T0 ds0 t0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 y0 w0 fs0 Hfresh0 Hneq0
      | t0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 x0 fs0
      | s0 t0 fs0 Sigma0 e0 Lv0 ].
    + (* red_read: heap unchanged *) left. exact Hpres.
    + (* red_write *)
      destruct (classic (y = yObj0)) as [-> | Hneq].
      * right.
        eapply write_mreach; eauto.
      * left.
        unfold heap_update in Hu0.
        destruct Hu0 as (_ & _ & _ & Hpreserve & _).
        eapply Hpreserve; eauto.
    + (* red_call: heap unchanged *) left. exact Hpres.
    + (* red_apply: heap unchanged *) left. exact Hpres.
    + (* red_let_fun: heap extended *)
      left.

      * exact Hpres.

    + (* red_let_obj: heap extended *)
      left.

      * exact Hpres.
      * eapply binds_fresh_head_neq; eauto.
    + (* red_let_var: heap unchanged *) left. exact Hpres.
    + (* red_let_push: heap unchanged *) left. exact Hpres.
Qed.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping ConfigTyping.
Require Import HeapUpdate OperationalSemantics MutableReachability.

Section WithRodotMode.
Context (typing_mode: Mode).
Context (Hmm: mode_has_mutability typing_mode).

(* A binding is a member of the domain. *)
Lemma imm_binds_in_dom A (S : env A) x v : @binds A x v S -> x \in dom S.
Proof. intros H. unfolds in H. eapply get_some_inv. eassumption. Qed.

(* A freshly allocated location is not a member of the domain. *)
Lemma imm_fresh_head_notin_dom (S : heap) (t : trm) (st : stack)
      (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  y \notin dom S.
Proof.
  intros Hf.
  unfold fresh_in_config in Hf.
  cbn [LibList.length] in Hf.
  destruct Hf as [Hy _].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [_ Hy].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [_ Hy].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [Hy _].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; tauto.
Qed.

(* A location already bound is distinct from a freshly allocated one. *)
Lemma imm_binds_fresh_head_neq (S : heap) (it : item) (z : var) (t : trm)
      (st : stack) (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  binds z it S ->
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  z <> y.
Proof.
  intros Hb Hf E. subst z.
  apply (imm_fresh_head_notin_dom Hf).
  eapply imm_binds_in_dom. eassumption.
Qed.

(* A heap update preserves every binding whose key is not the updated one. *)
Lemma imm_binds_heap_update_neq (S S' : heap) (x a : var) (l : fld_label)
      (y : var) (it : item) :
  heap_update S x l a S' -> y <> x -> binds y it S -> binds y it S'.
Proof.
  intros Hu Hne Hb.
  unfold heap_update in Hu.
  destruct Hu as (_ & _ & _ & Hpres & _).
  eapply Hpres; eauto.
Qed.

Theorem immutability_guarantee

Lemma imm_fresh_head_notin_dom (S : heap) (t : trm) (st : stack)
      (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->

  intros Hf.
  unfold fresh_in_config in Hf.
  cbn [LibList.length] in Hf.
  destruct Hf as [Hy _].

  apply notin_union_r in Hy; tauto.

Lemma imm_binds_fresh_head_neq (S : heap) (it : item) (z : var) (t : trm)
      (st : stack) (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  binds z it S ->
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  z <> y.

  intros Hb Hf E. subst z.
  apply (imm_fresh_head_notin_dom Hf).
  eapply imm_binds_in_dom. eassumption.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping ConfigTyping.
Require Import InertContext.
Lemma imm_subst_avar_commut : forall x y z n (a:avar),
  subst_var x y (open_rec n z a) = open_rec n (subst_var x y z) (subst_var x y a).
Proof.
  intros x y z n a. destruct a.
  - destruct (classic (n = n0)) as [Heq | Hne].
    + cbn.
      assert (H1 : (If n = n0 then avar_f z else avar_b n0) = avar_f z) by (apply If_l; exact Heq).
      rewrite H1.
      assert (H2 : (If n = n0 then avar_f (subst_var x y z) else avar_b n0) = avar_f (subst_var x y z)) by (apply If_l; exact Heq).
      rewrite H2. cbn. reflexivity.
    + cbn.
      assert (H1 : (If n = n0 then avar_f z else avar_b n0) = avar_b n0) by (apply If_r; exact Hne).
      rewrite H1.
      assert (H2 : (If n = n0 then avar_f (subst_var x y z) else avar_b n0) = avar_b n0) by (apply If_r; exact Hne).
      rewrite H2. cbn. reflexivity.
  - cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma imm_subst_open_commut_typ_dec : forall x y z,
  (forall (T:typ) n, subst_typ x y (open_rec_typ n z T) = open_rec_typ n (subst_var x y z) (subst_typ x y T)) /\
  (forall (D:dec) n, subst_dec x y (open_rec_dec n z D) = open_rec_dec n (subst_var x y z) (subst_dec x y D)).
Proof.
  intros x y z. apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n. reflexivity.
  - intros n. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH n. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.

  - intros t IHt n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros n. reflexivity.
  - intros L t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros f t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros m t IHt t0 IHt0 t1 IHt1 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0. apply IHt1.
Qed.

Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma imm_or_typ x n (T:typ) : open_rec n x T = open_rec_typ n x T.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

  - intros a m a0 n. cbn. f_equal; apply imm_subst_avar_commut.
  - intros T t IHt n. cbn.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping.

Require Import RecordTypes InertContext TFree.

Class MutableReachability := mutable_reachability: ctx -> config -> var -> Prop.

Notation "F ⊢ C 'mreach' y" := (mutable_reachability F C y) (at level 40, C at level 59).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive mut_reach : MutableReachability :=





| mreach_fld : forall (F : ctx) (t : trm) (fs : stack) (e : renv) (Sigma : heap) Lv
                 (y1 y2 : var) (ds : defs) (a : fld_label),

    inert F ->

    F ⊢ (t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) mreach y1 ->

    binds y1 (item_obj ds) Sigma -> defs_has ds (def_fld a (avar_f y2)) ->

    F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y1) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a typ_bot
        (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)) ->

    F ⊢ (t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) mreach y2






| mreach_trm : forall (F : ctx) (t : trm) (fs : stack) (e : renv) (Sigma : heap) Lv
                 (y w : var),

    inert F ->

    (tfree w t) \/ (tfree w fs) ->

    binds w y e ->

    F ⁏ e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f w) ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) ->

    F ⊢ (t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) mreach y
.

End WithTypingMode.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars Labels TransformCollect.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_or   : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> avar -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_fun  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_nocap: typ

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ: typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_fld: fld_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_met: met_label ->  typ -> typ -> typ -> dec
.

Notation typ_cap_marker C T := (typ_rcd (dec_typ (typ_label_refcap C) typ_bot T)) (only parsing).

Notation typ_mut_marker T := (typ_cap_marker typ_refcap_mutability T) (only parsing).

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)

with dec : Set :=

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L (open_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => typ_fun (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
                            (open_rec_typ (S k) u U)
  | dec_fld m T U => dec_fld m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR =>
    dec_met m (open_rec_typ (S k) u TC) (open_rec_typ k u TZ) (open_rec_typ (S (S k)) u TR)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_or T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L y   => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_fun T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_nocap => \{}
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_fld m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => (fv_typ TC) \u (fv_typ TZ) \u (fv_typ TR)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L (subst_var z u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_fun T U    => typ_fun (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_nocap => typ_nocap
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_fld L T U => dec_fld L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_met m TC TZ TR => dec_met m (subst_typ z u TC) (subst_typ z u TZ) (subst_typ z u TR)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Fixpoint seal_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (seal_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_or T1 T2  => typ_or (seal_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (seal_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L y => typ_sel (seal_rec k u x) L (seal_rec k u y)
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (seal_rec_typ (S k) u T)

Notation SubtypingPropery := (ctx -> renv -> typ -> typ -> Prop) (only parsing).

Module GeneralizedSubtyping.

Class AndOrSubtyping (ST: SubtypingPropery) := {
  and11 G e T U: ST G e (typ_and T U) T;
  and12 G e T U: ST G e (typ_and T U) U;
  and2 G e S T U:
    ST G e S T ->
    ST G e S U ->
    ST G e S (typ_and T U);
  or11 G e T U: ST G e T (typ_or T U);
  or12 G e T U: ST G e U (typ_or T U);
  or2 G e S T U:
    ST G e S T ->
    ST G e U T ->
    ST G e (typ_or S U) T;
  trans G e S T U:
    ST G e S T ->
    ST G e T U ->
    ST G e S U;
}.

End GeneralizedSubtyping.

End GeneralizedSubtypingLemmata.

  and12 := subtyp_and12 typing_mode;
  and2 := @subtyp_and2 typing_mode;
  or11 := subtyp_or11 typing_mode;
  or12 := subtyp_or12 typing_mode;
  or2 := @subtyp_or2 typing_mode;
  trans := @subtyp_trans typing_mode;
}.

Lemma imm_fresh_head_notin_dom (S : heap) (t : trm) (st : stack)

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Context Defs Heap.

Class TFree(A : Set) := tfree: var -> A -> Prop.

Inductive tfree_trm: TFree trm :=

| tfree_trm_var v:
  tfree_trm v (trm_var (avar_f v))

| tfree_trm_read v1 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_read (avar_f v1) l)

| tfree_trm_apply_l v1 a2:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_apply (avar_f v1) a2)
| tfree_trm_apply_r a1 v2:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_apply a1 (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_let_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_let_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_let t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_lit_l v t1 t2:
  tfree_lit v t1 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)
| tfree_trm_lit_r v t1 t2:
  tfree_trm v t2 ->
  tfree_trm v (trm_lit t1 t2)

| tfree_trm_write_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_write (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_write_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_write a1 l (avar_f v2))

| tfree_trm_call_l v1 a2 l:
  tfree_trm v1 (trm_call (avar_f v1) l a2)
| tfree_trm_call_r a1 v2 l:
  tfree_trm v2 (trm_call a1 l (avar_f v2))

with tfree_lit: TFree lit :=

| tfree_lit_fun v t T:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_fun T t)
| tfree_lit_obj v t T:
  tfree_defs v t ->
  tfree_lit v (lit_obj T t)

with tfree_def: TFree def :=

| tfree_def_trm v l:
  tfree_def v (def_fld l (avar_f v))

| tfree_def_met v t l:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_def v (def_met l t)

with tfree_defs: TFree defs :=

| tfree_defs_cons_l v d ds:
  tfree_defs v ds ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
| tfree_defs_cons_r v d ds:
  tfree_def v d ->
  tfree_defs v (defs_cons ds d)
.

Scheme tfree_trm_mut    := Induction for tfree_trm Sort Prop
with   tfree_lit_mut    := Induction for tfree_lit Sort Prop
with   tfree_def_mut    := Induction for tfree_def Sort Prop
with   tfree_defs_mut   := Induction for tfree_defs Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme tfree_mutind from tfree_trm_mut, tfree_lit_mut,
tfree_def_mut, tfree_defs_mut.

Inductive tfree_stack: TFree stack :=

| tfree_stack_cons_l v t st:
  tfree_trm v t ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons (frame_let t) st)
| tfree_stack_cons_r v f st:
  tfree_stack v st ->
  tfree_stack v (stack_cons f st)
.

Existing Instance tfree_trm.

Existing Instance tfree_lit.

Existing Instance tfree_def.

Existing Instance tfree_defs.

Existing Instance tfree_stack.

Lemma imm_open_twice_avar : forall n y x (a:avar), open_rec n y (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n x a.
Proof.
  intros n y x a. destruct a; cbn.
  - destruct (classic (n = n0)) as [Heq | Hne].
    + assert (H1 : (If n = n0 then avar_f x else avar_b n0) = avar_f x) by (apply If_l; exact Heq).
      rewrite H1. cbn. reflexivity.
    + assert (H1 : (If n = n0 then avar_f x else avar_b n0) = avar_b n0) by (apply If_r; exact Hne).
      rewrite H1. cbn.
      assert (H2 : (If n = n0 then avar_f y else avar_b n0) = avar_b n0) by (apply If_r; exact Hne).
      rewrite H2. reflexivity.
  - cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma imm_open_twice_typ_dec : forall x y,
  (forall (T:typ) n, open_rec_typ n y (open_rec_typ n x T) = open_rec_typ n x T) /\
  (forall (D:dec) n, open_rec_dec n y (open_rec_dec n x D) = open_rec_dec n x D).
Proof.
  intros x y. apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n. reflexivity.
  - intros n. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH n. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros a L a0 n. cbn. f_equal; apply imm_open_twice_avar.
  - intros t IHt n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.

  - intros L t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros f t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros m t IHt t0 IHt0 t1 IHt1 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0. apply IHt1.

Lemma imm_fv_open_cases_avar : forall x (a:avar) n,
  fv (open_rec n x a) = fv a \/ fv (open_rec n x a) = \{x} \u fv a.
Proof.
  intros x a n. destruct a.
  - destruct (classic (n = n0)) as [Heq | Hne].
    + assert (H : open_rec n x (avar_b n0) = avar_f x) by (apply If_l; exact Heq).
      rewrite H. right. cbn. rewrite union_empty_r. reflexivity.
    + assert (H : open_rec n x (avar_b n0) = avar_b n0) by (apply If_r; exact Hne).
      rewrite H. left. cbn. reflexivity.
  - left. cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma imm_open_twice_avar : forall n y x (a:avar), open_rec n y (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n x a.
Proof.
  intros n y x a. destruct a; cbn.
  - destruct (classic (n = n0)) as [Heq | Hne].
    + assert (H1 : (If n = n0 then avar_f x else avar_b n0) = avar_f x) by (apply If_l; exact Heq).

    + assert (H1 : (If n = n0 then avar_f x else avar_b n0) = avar_b n0) by (apply If_r; exact Hne).

(* A binding is a member of the domain. *)
Lemma imm_binds_in_dom A (S : env A) x v : @binds A x v S -> x \in dom S.
Proof. intros H. unfolds in H. eapply get_some_inv. eassumption. Qed.

(* A freshly allocated location is not a member of the domain. *)
Lemma imm_fresh_head_notin_dom (S : heap) (t : trm) (st : stack)
      (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  y \notin dom S.
Proof.
  intros Hf.
  unfold fresh_in_config in Hf.
  cbn [LibList.length] in Hf.
  destruct Hf as [Hy _].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [_ Hy].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [_ Hy].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; destruct Hy as [Hy _].
  apply notin_union_r in Hy; tauto.
Qed.

(* A location already bound is distinct from a freshly allocated one. *)
Lemma imm_binds_fresh_head_neq (S : heap) (it : item) (z : var) (t : trm)
      (st : stack) (e : renv) (Lv : fset var) (y w : var) :
  binds z it S ->
  fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (config_mk t st S e Lv) ->
  z <> y.
Proof.
  intros Hb Hf E. subst z.
  apply (imm_fresh_head_notin_dom Hf).
  eapply imm_binds_in_dom. eassumption.
Qed.

(* A heap update preserves every binding whose key is not the updated one. *)
Lemma imm_binds_heap_update_neq (S S' : heap) (x a : var) (l : fld_label)
      (y : var) (it : item) :
  heap_update S x l a S' -> y <> x -> binds y it S -> binds y it S'.
Proof.
  intros Hu Hne Hb.
  unfold heap_update in Hu.
  destruct Hu as (_ & _ & _ & Hpres & _).
  eapply Hpres; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma imm_ctx_binds_dom : forall G x T, ctx_binds x T G -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; cbn [ctx_dom].
  - rewrite in_union, in_singleton. auto.
  - rewrite in_union. right. assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Lemma imm_ctx_binds_unique : forall G x T1 T2,
  ctx_binds x T1 G -> ctx_binds x T2 G -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros G x T1 T2 H1. induction H1; intros H2.
  - inversion H2; subst; auto; try contradiction.
  - inversion H2; subst; try contradiction; eauto.
  - inversion H2; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma imm_inert_binds_typ : forall G x T,
  inert G -> ctx_binds x T G -> exists vk, inert_typ T vk.
Proof.
  intros G x T Hi. induction Hi as [ | G0 y vk T0 IH Hvk HT0 Hy Hcfv Hfv ];
  intros Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hb; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma imm_ctx_binds_push : forall G X T x vk S,
  ctx_binds X T G -> X <> x -> ctx_binds X T (G § x / vk ~ S).
Proof. intros. eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto. Qed.

Lemma imm_ctx_vis_push : forall G X x vk S,
  ctx_vis G X -> X <> x -> ctx_vis (G § x / vk ~ S) X.
Proof. intros. eapply ctx_vis_n; eauto. Qed.

Lemma imm_ctx_kdom_dom : forall G vk x, x \in ctx_kdom vk G -> x \in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intros G. induction G; intros vk x H; cbn [ctx_kdom ctx_dom] in *.
  - rewrite in_empty in H. tauto.
  - destruct (classic (vk = v0)) as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst vk. rewrite If_l in H by reflexivity.
      rewrite in_union in H. destruct H as [H | H].
      * rewrite in_singleton in H. subst. rewrite in_union, in_singleton. auto.
      * rewrite in_union. right. exact (IHG v0 x H).
    + rewrite If_r in H by assumption.
      rewrite in_union. right. exact (IHG vk x H).
  - exact (IHG vk x H).
  - exact (IHG vk x H).
Qed.

Lemma imm_binds_k_after_binds : forall v vk t G G2,
  ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G G2 -> ctx_binds v t G.
Proof.
  intros v vk t G G2 H. induction H.
  - apply ctx_binds_e.
  - eapply ctx_binds_n; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma imm_inert_binds_k_typ : forall G x vk t G2,
  inert G -> ctx_binds_k_after x vk t G G2 -> inert_typ t vk.
Proof.
  intros G x vk t G2 Hi. induction Hi as
    [ | G0 y vk0 t0 IH Hvk0 HT0 Hy Hcfv Hfv ]; intros Hk.
  - inversion Hk.
  - inversion Hk as [ | v v2 vk1 vk2 tt tt2 Hne Hk' G1 G2' ]; subst; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma imm_ctx_weakens_kdom_kind : forall G,
  ctx_weakens G -> ctx_ok G ->
  forall vk x, x \in ctx_kdom vk G -> exists t G2, ctx_binds_k_after x vk t G G2.
Proof.
  intros G Hw. induction Hw as [ | G0 y vk0 t0 Hw IH ]; intros Hok vk x Hx.
  - cbn [ctx_kdom] in Hx. rewrite in_empty in Hx. tauto.
  - cbn [ctx_kdom ctx_dom] in Hx.
    inversion Hok as [ | | | ]; subst.
    rename H into Hok0. rename H0 into Hy.
    destruct (classic (vk = vk0)) as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst vk. rewrite If_l in Hx by reflexivity.
      rewrite in_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx | Hx].
      * rewrite in_singleton in Hx. subst x. exists t0, G0. apply ctx_binds_k_e.
      * assert (Hne2 : x <> y).
        { intro E. subst x. apply Hy. apply imm_ctx_kdom_dom with (vk := vk0). exact Hx. }
        destruct (IH Hok0 vk0 x Hx) as [t [G2 Hk]].
        exists t, G2. eapply ctx_binds_k_n; eauto.
    + rewrite If_r in Hx by assumption.
      assert (Hne2 : x <> y).
      { intro E. subst x. apply Hy. apply imm_ctx_kdom_dom with (vk := vk). exact Hx. }
      destruct (IH Hok0 vk x Hx) as [t [G2 Hk]].
      exists t, G2. eapply ctx_binds_k_n; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma imm_inert_ctx_vis : forall G x T,
  inert G -> ctx_binds x T G -> ctx_vis G x.
Proof.
  intros G x T Hi. induction Hi as
    [ | G0 y vk t0 IH Hvk HT Hy Hcfv Hfv ]; intros Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - inversion Hb as [ | v v2 vk2 t2 Hne Hb' | v t2 Hsub ]; subst.
    + apply ctx_vis_e.
    + eapply ctx_vis_n; eauto.
Qed.

(* ---- beginning of the substitution metatheory (SubstFresh for typ/dec) ---- *)
Lemma imm_ni_union (x:var) (E F: vars) : x \notin E \u F -> x \notin E /\ x \notin F.
Proof. intros H. exact (proj1 (notin_union x E F) H). Qed.

Lemma imm_ni_single (x y : var) : x \notin \{y} -> x <> y.
Proof. intros H. exact (notin_singleton_r H). Qed.

Lemma imm_subst_fresh_avar : forall x y (a:avar), x \notin fv a -> subst_var x y a = a.
Proof.
  intros x y a H. destruct a; cbn in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply imm_ni_single in H. cbn.
    rewrite If_r. reflexivity.
    intro E. apply H. symmetry. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma imm_subst_fresh_typ_dec : forall x y,
  (forall T : typ, x \notin fv T -> subst_typ x y T = T) /\
  (forall D : dec, x \notin fv D -> subst_dec x y D = D).
Proof.
  intros x y. apply typ_mutind.
  - intros _. reflexivity.
  - intros _. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH Hnot. cbn. rewrite (IH Hnot). reflexivity.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 Hnot. cbn.
    destruct (imm_ni_union Hnot) as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHt H1), (IHt0 H2). reflexivity.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 Hnot. cbn.
    destruct (imm_ni_union Hnot) as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHt H1), (IHt0 H2). reflexivity.
  - intros a L a0 Hnot. cbn.
    destruct (imm_ni_union Hnot) as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (@imm_subst_fresh_avar x y a H1), (@imm_subst_fresh_avar x y a0 H2). reflexivity.
  - intros t IH Hnot. cbn. rewrite (IH Hnot). reflexivity.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 Hnot. cbn.
    destruct (imm_ni_union Hnot) as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHt H1), (IHt0 H2). reflexivity.
  - intros _. reflexivity.
  - intros L t IHt t0 IHt0 Hnot. cbn.
    destruct (imm_ni_union Hnot) as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHt H1), (IHt0 H2). reflexivity.
  - intros f t IHt t0 IHt0 Hnot. cbn.
    destruct (imm_ni_union Hnot) as [H1 H2].
    rewrite (IHt H1), (IHt0 H2). reflexivity.
  - intros m t IHt t0 IHt0 t1 IHt1 Hnot. cbn.
    destruct (imm_ni_union Hnot) as [H1 H23].
    destruct (imm_ni_union H23) as [H2 H3].
    rewrite (IHt H1), (IHt0 H2), (IHt1 H3). reflexivity.

Lemma imm_subst_avar_commut : forall x y z n (a:avar),
  subst_var x y (open_rec n z a) = open_rec n (subst_var x y z) (subst_var x y a).
Proof.
  intros x y z n a. destruct a.
  - destruct (classic (n = n0)) as [Heq | Hne].
    + cbn.
      assert (H1 : (If n = n0 then avar_f z else avar_b n0) = avar_f z) by (apply If_l; exact Heq).
      rewrite H1.
      assert (H2 : (If n = n0 then avar_f (subst_var x y z) else avar_b n0) = avar_f (subst_var x y z)) by (apply If_l; exact Heq).
      rewrite H2. cbn. reflexivity.
    + cbn.
      assert (H1 : (If n = n0 then avar_f z else avar_b n0) = avar_b n0) by (apply If_r; exact Hne).
      rewrite H1.
      assert (H2 : (If n = n0 then avar_f (subst_var x y z) else avar_b n0) = avar_b n0) by (apply If_r; exact Hne).
      rewrite H2. cbn. reflexivity.
  - cbn. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma imm_subst_open_commut_typ_dec : forall x y z,
  (forall (T:typ) n, subst_typ x y (open_rec_typ n z T) = open_rec_typ n (subst_var x y z) (subst_typ x y T)) /\
  (forall (D:dec) n, subst_dec x y (open_rec_dec n z D) = open_rec_dec n (subst_var x y z) (subst_dec x y D)).
Proof.
  intros x y z. apply typ_mutind.
  - intros n. reflexivity.
  - intros n. reflexivity.
  - intros d IH n. cbn. f_equal. apply IH.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros a L a0 n. cbn. f_equal; apply imm_subst_avar_commut.
  - intros t IHt n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt.
  - intros t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros n. reflexivity.
  - intros L t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros f t IHt t0 IHt0 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0.
  - intros m t IHt t0 IHt0 t1 IHt1 n. cbn. f_equal. apply IHt. apply IHt0. apply IHt1.
Qed.
